thread:
kevin: Observed a small but reproducible quota spike during onboarding in the sample app. Users hit 429s when signup triggers a silent reauth and prefetch keeps running.

sara: I can reproduce with SAMPLE_PREFETCH=5. After the token refresh, the prefetch workers all refire and many request the same cursor concurrently. Server returns a cluster of 429s.

yun: quick idea: implement a cursor-level singleflight to dedupe concurrent fetches, plus a short pause when auth.refreshInProgress === true. That should stop the fanout.

kevin: repro logs: ```[2024-11-03T12:01:05.000Z] prefetch workers=5 cursor=cur_12
[2024-11-03T12:01:05.120Z] auth: refresh start
[2024-11-03T12:01:05.390Z] http 429 GET /list?cursor=cur_12 (concurrent=5)
[2024-11-03T12:01:05.700Z] retrying cur_12 backoff=80ms```

sara: workarounds: lower SAMPLE_PREFETCH to 1 during signup flows or add random jitter to prefetch start times. Not ideal for perf.

yun: patch sketch: `if (inFlight.has(cursor)) return inFlight.get(cursor)` and `if (auth.refreshing) await auth.waitForRefresh()` when prefetchMode === 'conservative'. Also add AbortController per fetch to cancel stale prefetches.

kevin: also propose telemetry key `sdk.prefetch.duplicate_count` so we can measure how often the same cursor is requested concurrently.

bot-ci: Created job devex/prefetch-conserve-e2e to run in staging with forced token expiry for coverage.

sara: parity: expose prefetchMode in all SDKs. JS gets opt-in `prefetch: { mode: 'conservative' | 'default' | 'singleflight' }`. Please coordinate with py/go.

yun: I'll open a small PR implementing singleflight + abortion + telemetry and add unit tests. If clean, flip sample-app to conservative for signup flow.

kevin: thanks. please tag owners=@devex and dx:prefetch in the PR. Follow up tomorrow 9:30 to pick defaults and rollout plan.
